summary: Eldorado Gold Corporation filed a Form 6-K on July 30, 2026, reporting its Q2 2026 financial and operational results via a news release. The filing covers gold production of 104,616 ounces, revenue of $487.5 million, and updates to 2026 production guidance. It mentions cash flows related to the acquisition of Foran Mining Corporation, but the acquisition is not the subject of this filing; it occurred previously and is only referenced. The filing is a routine earnings report and does not constitute a special-situations event, such as a merger, tender offer, or strategic review.
